 Description 
Our client is an international company, supplying essential industrial gases and related equipment to various sectors, focusing on innovation and sustainability. They lead in the development of large-scale gas projects that convert natural resources into valuable products. Known for their operational excellence and commitment to safety and the environment, they are dedicated to creating solutions that benefit communities worldwide. 
We are looking for a motivated Operator Depot to join their team in the Halfweg area of North Holland. 
In this hands-on role, you will support the gas cylinder filling process by handling, loading, and monitoring gas holders, ensuring all depot operations run smoothly and safely. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys practical work, teamwork, and maintaining high safety standards in a fast-paced environment. 
Job Profile for Operator Depot 
Responsibilities will include but not be limited to: - Support the gas cylinder filling process by handling and processing gas cylinders - Load and unload gas cylinders from trucks - Sort gas cylinders and place them in the correct process flow - Monitor gas cylinders and report irregularities or defects ...

Looking for a job where every day is different, you stay active, and your work truly matters? Then this could be the opportunity you’ve been looking for! Wie zoeken we? You’ll work at our modern DHL Campus, a clean, safe, and high-tech environment where teamwork and quality are at the heart of everything we do. You’ll handle a wide range of products, from everyday goods to essential pharmaceutical products. Your work helps make sure these products reach the right place at the right time. Do you enjoy working with technology and building complex products? In this role as a Assembly Operator, you will work on high-quality electromechanical systems within an innovative high-tech production environment. You will join an international organization where technology, quality, and collaboration are central. Together with a team of technicians, you will build modules and systems that are used worldwide in advanced technology applications. What’s your job about? As a Technician Assembler, you will be responsible for assembling complex technical systems and modules. You ensure that products are accurately built according to technical drawings and work instructions. Your tasks include: Assembling mechanical and electromechanical modules and systems Working according to technical drawings, schematics, and work instructions Building cabinets, subassemblies, and components Performing quality checks and measurements Identifying deviations and contributing to improvements Collaborating with colleagues from production, engineering, and quality departments You will work in a two-shift schedule: Morning shift: 06:00 – 14:15 Afternoon shift: 14:15 – 23:00 Friday: until approximately 20:30 What skills do you have? For this role, we are looking for a technician with attention to detail and an interest in high-tech production: Affinity with technology or assembly work Experience assembling machines, modules, or technical products is a plus Ability to read technical drawings, or willingness to learn Accurate and quality-focused working style Hands-on mentality and a sense of responsibility Good command of English (international working environment) What do you get in return? A position within an innovative high-tech organization Salary between €3,300 – €3,400 gross per month, including shift allowance Plenty of opportunities to develop your technical skills Training and educational opportunities Career growth possibilities within technology or engineering A competitive

salary including shift allowance In an advanced production environment in the Eindhoven region, you will be involved in the entire electronics process, from the first concept to the final product. Here, precision technologies such as Surface Mount Technology (SMT) are widely used. An SMD Technician, or Surface Mount Device Technician, plays a crucial role in this type of company, especially when it comes to the production of electronic circuit boards, also known as PCBs (Printed Circuit Boards).

Vacancy ID: 4485 | Location: Waddinxveen, Logistics Centre Rotterdam, DACHSER Netherlands B.V. | Employment: Full-time | Contract: Fixed-term | Job category: Warehousing / Order Picking; Road Transport / Freight Forwarding 
As a Transit Terminal Operator, you will work in the cross-dock warehouse at DACHSER in Waddinxveen, part of our Logistics Centre Rotterdam in the Netherlands. Together with your colleagues, you make sure that goods are loaded, unloaded and processed safely, accurately and on time. 
You will work with an electric pallet truck (EPT) and a handheld scanner. As our logistics operation runs around the clock, you may work different shifts depending on the operation and your availability. 
"Together, we make sure every shipment leaves safely and on time." 
Your main tasks are: - Loading and unloading trailers and swap bodies. - Moving pallets with an electric pallet truck (EPT). - Scanning goods with a handheld scanner. - Placing goods in the correct location in the warehouse. - Checking whether goods are properly packed. - Reporting damage or other issues to your supervisor. 
Working hours 
You work 40 hours per week. You can work different shifts, depending on the operation and your availability. 
Possible shifts include: - Morning shift - Afternoon/evening shift - Night shift 
Together, we will look at which shift works best for you. 
Who are you? - You enjoy active and physical work. - You work well with colleagues. - You work safely and accurately. - You are flexible with working hours. - You speak Dutch or English. - You are available full-time. About DACHSER 
Logistics is People Business - this vision underlines the fact that our people are the driving force behind DACHSER's success. 
Founded in 1930, our family-owned company has grown into one of the world's leading logistics service providers. Through our global logistics network, we provide intelligent logistics solutions for our customers....
